title: Batch 12 review leftovers: tests and doc drift
description:
Minor findings from batch 12 review (HEAD 1a26cf40):
1. 3rq7: no test that an @everyone (targetId = Space id) override reaches the federation (deliver.rs:686) and VTC (vtc-server lib.rs:548) paths; add one deny-send test per crate.
2. 6itf.11: no test that resolve_with_hint ignores the hint for did:key; get_hinted falls back to the method URL on any FetchError including TooLarge, while did-00 L194 defines unreachable as network error / HTTP 4xx/5xx (decide: treat TooLarge as a hard failure).
3. u2ol: peer-auth-io crate-doc bullet not rewrapped (~100 cols).
4. 510h.55: no test for the onExists newest cascade (filenode.rs ~L1959-1964); no negative test that destroyed is omitted when a collision is rejected (newest not strictly later -> alreadyExists; replace on Directory with children without onDestroyRemoveChildren).
5. 0x0q.76: crate-jmap-chat-filenode-server/README.md L33 files_rights row not updated for created entries.
6. w1lm: README trait listings and PLAN.md files still use the old supports_type summary ('Returns true if this account supports the given JMAP object type.').
